transitions.name: Iris open
transitions.desc: A circle grows from the exact tap point and reveals the next screen.

transitions.name: Blade wipe
transitions.desc: The new screen slides in behind a shiny steel edge, like a blade passing over.

transitions.name: Curtain split
transitions.desc: The old screen splits down the middle and slides out to both sides.

transitions.name: Venetian blinds
transitions.desc: Eight vertical slats rotate to show the new screen.

transitions.name: Pixel bloom
transitions.desc: Square pixels pop up in random order until the new screen is complete.

transitions.name: Diamond open
transitions.desc: A diamond-shaped window opens from the centre.

transitions.name: Zoom through
transitions.desc: The old screen zooms past the camera while the new one settles from slightly large.

transitions.name: 3D card flip
transitions.desc: The screen flips like a card around a vertical axis.

transitions.name: Parallax push
transitions.desc: The new screen pushes the old one away, background layers move at different speeds.

transitions.name: Drop and bounce
transitions.desc: The new screen drops from above, squashes, and bounces once.

transitions.name: Blade swing
transitions.desc: The new screen swings out from a hinge like a pocket-knife blade opening, with a click at the end.

transitions.name: Camera shutter
transitions.desc: Seven shutter blades close over the old screen and open on the new one.

transitions.name: Film-strip roll
transitions.desc: The old screen rolls up like a film strip and the new one rolls in.

transitions.name: Page curl
transitions.desc: The corner of the old screen curls back to reveal the new one.

transitions.name: Water ripple
transitions.desc: A ripple spreads from the tap and bends the old screen into the new one.

transitions.name: Glitch slice
transitions.desc: Horizontal slices slide sideways with a quick colour split, then settle.

transitions.name: Liquid morph
transitions.desc: The tapped button melts into a blob that spreads and becomes the new screen.

transitions.name: Ink splash
transitions.desc: Ink splashes from the tap and floods the screen, then the new screen shows through.

transitions.name: Confetti sweep
transitions.desc: A wave of confetti sweeps across and leaves the new screen behind it.

transitions.name: Clock wipe
transitions.desc: A clock hand sweeps around and reveals the new screen behind it.

transitions.name: Spiral twist
transitions.desc: The old screen twists into a spiral and the new one unwinds.

transitions.name: Gooey merge
transitions.desc: Blobs of colour merge like liquid metal and become the new screen.

transitions.name: Shatter and assemble
transitions.desc: The old screen cracks into tiles that fly away while the new tiles fly in.

transitions.name: Mosaic resolve
transitions.desc: The new screen starts as big blocks and sharpens to full resolution.

transitions.name: Sunrise sweep
transitions.desc: A band of warm light sweeps up the screen and the new screen glows in.

transitions.name: Card shuffle
transitions.desc: The old screen becomes a card, shuffles into a deck, and the new card is dealt on top.

transitions.name: Tummy portal
transitions.desc: A round portal opens from Pip's tummy and the new screen grows out of it.

transitions.name: Pip pulls the screen
transitions.desc: Pip runs across the screen pulling the new screen behind him like a curtain.

transitions.name: Unzip
transitions.desc: A zipper runs down the screen and the new screen is behind it.

transitions.name: Sticker peel
transitions.desc: The old screen peels off like a sticker from one corner.

transitions.name: Tool flip
transitions.desc: Pip's blade quiff flips to the tool's icon, the icon scales up to fill the screen and becomes the new page.

transitions.name: Vortex
transitions.desc: The old screen is sucked into a point and the new one blooms from the same point.

zones.name: Tummy
zones.tap: Opens the tools menu (radial, 6 tools). Pip giggles. Three different giggles are picked at random.
zones.dwell: Pip looks down, pats his tummy and says hmm (1.5 s), then the radial menu peeks open halfway as a hint (3 s).

zones.name: Blade quiff
zones.tap: The blade flips to another tool (scissors, magnifier, crop corner, clapper). Plays a click.
zones.dwell: Pip crosses his eyes to look at his blade (1 s). Press and hold while he is standing still (0.6 s) = PICK UP (see below).

zones.name: Eyes
zones.tap: He blinks hard and says ouch, or winks. Three variants.
zones.dwell: Eyes follow the pointer closely, pupils get big (1 s), then he leans in until he is almost cross-eyed (3 s), then he blinks and pushes the pointer away (5 s).

zones.name: Mouth
zones.tap: He sticks out his tongue, blows a raspberry, or tries to bite the pointer. Three variants.
zones.dwell: He opens his mouth and waits (1.5 s), tries to nibble the pointer (3 s), then makes a funny face and pretends to be full (6 s).

zones.name: Shoulder rivets (his "ears")
zones.tap: The knob rings like a bell and his head wobbles. Left and right give different notes.
zones.dwell: The knob twitches (1 s), he tilts his head toward it (2.5 s), then he wiggles it to say stop (5 s).

zones.name: Hands (left and right)
zones.tap: Left: high-five. Right: handshake. Both with a small spark.
zones.dwell: He holds out the hand and waits (1.5 s), taps his foot (3 s), then shrugs and puts it down (5 s).

zones.name: Feet
zones.tap: He hops, kicks, or stomps. Three variants, small dust puff.
zones.dwell: He wiggles his toes (1 s), giggles because it tickles (2 s). After 2.5 s steady, the pointer turns into a MINI MAGIC CARPET (see below).

zones.name: Belt
zones.tap: The belt buckle clicks and he shows his tool count.
zones.dwell: He sucks in his tummy and says tight.

zones.name: Keyring tail
zones.tap: The keyring spins like a propeller and Pip turns with it.
zones.dwell: He chases his own tail slowly (2 s) and gets dizzy (5 s).

zones.name: Space around Pip
zones.tap: Pip looks at the tap and waves. Double tap makes him jump toward it.
zones.dwell: He follows the pointer with his eyes, then loses interest and starts an idle action (8 s).

gestures.name: Pick up by the blade
gestures.how: Press and hold the blade quiff for 0.6 s while Pip is standing still (not mid-action).
gestures.result: Pip is lifted by the blade, his feet dangle and swing like a pendulum, eyes go wide, he squeals. He follows the pointer with physics (spring and pendulum). Fast moves make him fly sideways with the legs trailing. Release = he falls with gravity, squashes on landing, bounces twice, stars circle his head. A fast flick = he flies away, bounces off the screen edges and comes to rest. Dropping on a tool tile or the Save button counts as a tap on it.

gestures.name: Magic carpet
gestures.how: Keep the pointer (or a held finger) on a foot, still, for 2.5 s.
gestures.result: The cursor turns into a small flying carpet with tassels. The carpet slides under Pip, lifts him, and he sits cross-legged on it. The carpet follows the pointer with a delay, banks into turns, and the keyring tail trails behind. Desktop: the real cursor is replaced by the carpet. Touch: the carpet appears under the held finger. Sudden jerk (pointer speed above 2500 px per second change in under 80 ms) or any click or tap: the carpet bursts into threads and sparkles, Pip falls, squashes, shakes it off and says oops. Lifting a held finger gently lands the carpet softly and it folds away.

gestures.name: Shake the phone
gestures.how: Device shake (accelerometer) on Android; fast pointer shake on the web.
gestures.result: Pip gets dizzy and loose bolts fall out. 3 shakes in 5 s and he says stop.

gestures.name: Tickle swipe
gestures.how: Swipe quickly across his tummy three times.
gestures.result: He laughs uncontrollably and falls over.

gestures.name: Rapid taps
gestures.how: Three or more taps within 2 s anywhere on Pip.
gestures.result: He gets dizzy, spiral eyes, stars. Five taps and he pretends to be annoyed and turns his back.

gestures.name: Long idle
gestures.result: He yawns and falls asleep (Z letters). Any touch wakes him with a small start.

gestures.name: Press and hold the background
gestures.how: Hold anywhere that is not Pip for 1 s.
gestures.result: Pip walks over and sits next to the finger.
